source_metadata.exact_title: Pharmacokinetics of intraperitoneal cefalothin and cefazolin in patients being treated for peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis

atoms.canonical_statement: The study aimed to determine intraperitoneal and systemic pharmacokinetics of cefalothin and cefazolin in patients treated for PD-peritonitis and assess whether exposures were compatible with maximal antibacterial activity.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The aim of this study is to determine the IP and systemic pharmacokinetics of cefalothin and cefazolin.

atoms.canonical_statement: This was a prospective observational pharmacokinetic study in patients with peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: this prospective observational pharmacokinetic study involved PD patients

population.label: Adults with peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis receiving intraperitoneal first-generation cephalosporin therapy

atoms.canonical_statement: Eligible patients were at least 18 years old, had been maintained on CAPD or APD for at least 1 month, and had clinically confirmed PD-peritonitis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients were eligible if at least 18 years old and maintained on continuous ambulatory PD (CAPD) or automated PD (APD) for at least 1 month.

population.label: Eligible PD-peritonitis patients
inclusion_criteria: CAPD or APD for at least 1 month
Clinical PD-peritonitis confirmed by effluent cell count, differential, and culture

atoms.canonical_statement: Patients who had received a course of intraperitoneal antibiotics in the preceding 2 weeks were excluded.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients who had received a course of IP antibiotics in the preceding 2 weeks were not eligible for the study.

population.label: Study eligibility
exclusion_criteria: Course of intraperitoneal antibiotics in the preceding 2 weeks

atoms.canonical_statement: Cefalothin was administered intraperitoneally at 15 mg/kg once daily with gentamicin in a 2-L dialysate bag and allowed to dwell for 6 hours.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 15 mg/kg of cefalothin or cefazolin ... and gentamicin were added to a 2-L dialysate bag

exposures.details: Added with gentamicin to a 2-L dialysate bag; physician-selected cephalosporin.

atoms.canonical_statement: Cefazolin was administered intraperitoneally at 15 mg/kg once daily with gentamicin in a 2-L dialysate bag and allowed to dwell for 6 hours.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 15 mg/kg of cefalothin or cefazolin ... and gentamicin were added to a 2-L dialysate bag

exposures.details: Added with gentamicin to a 2-L dialysate bag; physician-selected cephalosporin.

atoms.canonical_statement: Blood samples were collected at 1, 3, 6, 7, and 24 hours after the first antibiotic-containing intraperitoneal dwell.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Serial blood samples were collected ... at 1, 3, 6, 7 and 24 hours after the IP administration

atoms.canonical_statement: Peritoneal effluent was sampled at 3 and 6 hours and at the end of the next three dialysis exchanges through 24 hours.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Effluent samples were collected at 3 and 6 hours and at the end of the 3 subsequent dialysis exchanges up to 24 hours

atoms.canonical_statement: Cefazolin and cefalothin concentrations were measured by UHPLC-MS/MS; lower limits of quantitation across plasma and PD effluent matrices were 0.1-1.0 mg/L for cefazolin and 0.2-1 mg/L for cefalothin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Cefazolin and cefalothin were measured by UHPLC-MS/MS

atoms.canonical_statement: Pharmacokinetic parameters were estimated using a noncompartmental approach; concentrations below the lower limit of quantification were treated as zero.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A noncompartmental pharmacokinetic approach was used ... Concentrations less than the lower limit of quantification were considered zero.

atoms.canonical_statement: Continuous variables were summarized as medians with interquartile ranges and compared by Mann-Whitney test; proportions were compared by Fisher exact or chi-square tests with p<0.05 considered significant.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Continuous variables are expressed as median (interquartile range)

atoms.canonical_statement: Nineteen patients were included: 8 received cefalothin and 11 received cefazolin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Nineteen patients were included in this study (cefalothin n = 8 and cefazolin n = 11).

population.label: Adults with peritoneal dialysis-associated peritonitis receiving intraperitoneal first-generation cephalosporin therapy

atoms.canonical_statement: The cefalothin and cefazolin groups did not differ significantly in age, weight, antibiotic dose, urine output, or creatinine clearance at baseline.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: There were no statistically significant differences ... in terms of age, weight, antibiotic dose, urine output, or CrCL.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that once-daily intraperitoneal cefazolin produced a concentration-time profile more compatible with sustained antibacterial activity than once-daily cefalothin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Intraperitoneal cefazolin ... appears to result in a concentration-time profile that optimizes bacterial kill, in comparison with IP cefalothin.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors proposed cefazolin as the preferred first-generation cephalosporin when once-daily intraperitoneal dosing is used for PD-peritonitis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: cefazolin may be the preferred treatment when a first-generation cephalosporin is to be given once daily

atoms.canonical_statement: The elimination phase was estimated from only two plasma samples, limiting characterization of terminal pharmacokinetics.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the elimination phase was determined using only 2 samples.

atoms.canonical_statement: The small sample limited subanalyses of peritoneal membrane transporter status and residual renal function.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Some subanalyses could not be performed due to the small number of patients

atoms.canonical_statement: The study evaluated only the initial dose, so repeated-dose concentrations and accumulation over the treatment course were not determined.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This is a single-dose study following the initial dose, so the effects of repeated doses ... are not determined.

atoms.canonical_statement: The influence of residual renal function on cefazolin and cefalothin pharmacokinetics was not fully resolved.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the effect of residual renal function may not have been fully explored in this study

atoms.canonical_statement: The supplement states that more frequent cefalothin dosing may be required and notes an ISPD continuous regimen of 500 mg/L loading then 125 mg/L in each exchange, while stating that attainment of defined concentration targets remains unclear.

atoms.canonical_statement: The supplement notes that residual renal function could influence cephalosporin exposure and that its effect could not be excluded in the small study.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: although this was not a statistically-significant issue in our study, an effect cannot be excluded.
